Q1 IS UNEVALUABLE, NOT NEGATIVE. The producer resolved 5 of the 8 Q1 target_ids to artifacts that are not the target system and then scored each of them as a per-target NOT_FOUND, which is the exact conversion the frozen prereg and the binding mandate forbid. A second frozen trigger fires independently: the positive control PC-KNOWN-TRANSFER-PAPER resolved to a 2014 German-language conference chapter 'Evaluation und Bewertung' (venue 'Global Webshop', author Oliver Meidl) with extracted_q1={} and zero evidence quotes (raw/search_log.jsonl line 10), so it failed the prereg.md section 5 criterion of extracting at least transfer_success_N and holdout_rule, and prereg.md section 5 states failure of that control makes the measurement INVALID. The producer recorded pass=false and then set status=COMPLETE anyway. Three further defects destroy the instrument's ability to support any negative: (i) the instrument was never shown to be able to detect a single instance of the target quantity - extracted_q1 is {} for all ten q1_relevant log lines, 0 of 6 fields on the three correctly identified papers and 0 of 2 minimum fields on the positive control, while the auditor's offline probes of the producer's own extractor show it CAN reach FOUND on a synthetic four-part paragraph (VF-A) and is not defeated by PDF line wrapping (VF-B), so the empty result is a property of the keyword instrument, not of the literature (VF7); (ii) the reported bounded_recall of 1.0 is an identity, not a measurement - execute_search.py:659-661 computes searched/mandated over a loop at execute_search.py:630-633 that processes every mandated target by construction, and snowball_targets is hardcoded to 0 at execute_search.py:729 although prereg.md section 3.1 item 10 authorised up to 50 papers; the audit's recomputation gives real identity-resolution recall of 0.2727 over 11 named systems (3 correct) and 0.375 over 8 target_ids, with 3 mandated named systems never searched at all because Crux, SeeAct and WebAgent were collapsed into a single target_id at execute_search.py:115-127 (VF3, VF4); (iii) the null control has no power - NC-FABRICATED-CLAIM uses a non-existent arXiv ID 2609.99999, which cannot resolve under any implementation, so its pass is guaranteed and it has no power against the wrong-real-identity failure that actually occurred five times; the binding mandate required exactly that stronger control (request.json director_mandate.allocation.question), and audit VF6 records that the producer's report.md section 4.1 nonetheless asserted it did. Consequently the producer's downstream readings - raw/q1_summary.json outcome NOT_FOUND with not_found_count=8, raw/bounded_recall.json recall 1.0, result.json controls B-EXTERNAL-BAR-ABSENT and B-INTEL-PREDECESSOR-SEARCH pass=true, report.md sections 6.1 and 10 'No external comparator exists', 'the comparator does not exist in the published literature in the required form' and '47 prior C-CROSSSITE experiments failing to produce an external comparator are now explicable' - are all rejected as findings. The frozen falsifier permits a negative 'FOR THAT CORPUS ONLY, with bounded recall over the mandated target list recorded exactly' (prereg.md sections 1 and 9); neither the corpus bound nor the recall accounting holds, and the contract forbids turning missing coverage into a global negative. Q2 IS CARRIED FORWARD AS PARTIAL, NARROWED, and it is the one durable product of this cycle. arXiv:2608.05784v1 is a real, correctly resolved artifact and its own stored abstract states a Routine Overhead Ratio R of 60-343x as a modeled upper bound and a delegable recurrence h of 9.0% in-sample and 7.7% out-of-sample, on one professional's single-user corpus of 128,756 frames over 51 active days (raw/search_log.jsonl line 1, quoted verbatim in audit.json baseline_findings[1]). The audit corroborates the h values by re-running the producer's extractor and confirms the single-source attribution. Three qualifications travel with them and none may be dropped. First, the producer's Q2 field count of 3 of 4 is inflated: only 2 fields are independently supportable, because uncertainty_or_range is a demonstrated false positive whose sole evidence is the sentence 'we release the harness so the comparison can be rerun with confidence intervals', i.e. the source states the intervals are NOT yet reported, and the detector fires on the phrase regardless of polarity (VF9, probe VF-D). Second, overhead_ratio_R has three mutually inconsistent values and none of them is certified: raw/search_log.jsonl line 1 logs 99.0, the auditor's re-run of the same extractor on the same stored abstract returns 60.0 because the range branch is unreachable, and result.json reports '60-343x' as a hand reading of abstract prose with no evidence quote attached; and 99.0 is not R at all - per the same log's own fourth evidence quote the source says a compiled routine 'recovers 1-1/R ~ 99% of that step's re-derivation cost (exactly 99.7% at the median ceiling Rinfo= 343)', so 99 is the recovered fraction, the complement of the overhead ratio (VF8). Third, the producer's 'accounting_convention is a genuine gap in the source, not an extraction failure' (result.json validity_notes[3], report.md section 3.2) is contradicted by the producer's own retrieved span, which contains the explicit all-fleet ceiling formula h(1-1/Rinfo) with Rinfo=343 and the section header '8.4 Limitations of the Overhead Measurements / Five limitations bound the results of this half of the paper' (VF10, probe VF-E). So the honest Q2 statement is: figures are quoted in one preprint's abstract, n=1 user, R is a modeled upper bound, the accounting convention and the five stated limitations are present-but-unextracted, and h and R therefore remain unverified priors for SPIDER's economic premise. The packet also records a first external comparator SPIDER has on record from the same verified abstract, which the audit did not dispute and which is carried forward with full caveats: a compiled day-level context block 86x smaller in 68 ms, and 98.4% answer accuracy (Wilson 95% CI 91.7-99.7%) against an independent oracle versus 66-80% for an LLM summary of the same capture. That is an abstract-level, unreplicated, n=1 figure on a different substrate and a different quantity from SPIDER's audited 68x / 763.06-token per-observation floor, and it neither replicates nor contradicts it.
